# The original page-size test checks a remembered request preference rather than returned item count

The original task syncs six messages from null state and checks lastMaxMessagePageSize equals 256. The fake Graph server records a matching header without clearing that value when the header is absent, while actual response counts use maxSyncItems separately. Accepted later code clears missing-header state and adds saved-token and paged scenarios. This preserves what the original assertion directly checks; it does not establish every request header, returned count or a live server cap.

Scope: Exchange page-size test instrumentation.
